title: Ikebukuro on Foot
blurb: Walk Ikebukuro under the real sun: along Sunshine 60-dori to the tower, round Otome Road's shops, and through the station to West Gate Park's ring.

travel.name: Ikebukuro Station, East exit 東口
West Gate Park, the ring 池袋西口公園
Sunshine 60, the foot サンシャイン60

npcs.name: Hiro 宏
idle: Ikebukuro is the ramen battlefield. Forty shops within ten minutes of the station, and every one says it's the best.
Mine's tonkotsu, twelve hours on the bone. {time}.

npcs.name: Yumi 由美
idle: Our penguins swim over your head, against the sky: a glass tank on the roof, forty metres up.
The sea lions eat at three. Come and watch. {sun_line}

npcs.name: Rin 凛
idle: Otome Road's shops sell to women fans: books, badges, acrylic stands. Akihabara has the boys; we have the girls.
The butler cafe's just round the corner. 'Welcome home, my lady.'

npcs.name: Kaito 海斗
idle: We practise under the ring at night: the glass of the theatre's a good mirror.
This park was in a TV drama in 2000. My father still calls it the West Gate Park, like the kids in it.

quests.title: Ikebukuro
talk: Welcome to Ikebukuro! The east exit has Seibu, the west exit has Tobu. Don't ask me why; nobody knows.
Walk down Sunshine 60-dori to the tower. Yumi at the aquarium knows the east side better than anyone.

quests.title: Sunshine 60
talk: Look up: Sunshine 60. From the deck you can see Fuji on a clear morning.
Behind us is Otome Road. Rin works in a bookshop there.

quests.title: Otome Road
talk: Welcome to Otome Road. Pick a shop, any shop. Second floor up is where the good stuff is.
And if you're tired: the butler cafe. They call everyone 'my lady'.

quests.title: West Gate Park
talk: West Gate Park. Through the station and out the other side: everybody gets lost the first time.
Look at the ring after dark. Five rings of light, over the theatre.

smalltalk: お帰りなさいませ、お嬢様。

spots.name: Sunshine 60 サンシャイン60
lines: Sunshine 60: 240 metres, the tallest in Asia when it opened in 1978. Sixty floors, and an aquarium on the roof of the building beside it.
The prison where the war's leaders were held stood here. They built a city on it, and a park for the people who remembered.

spots.name: Otome Road 乙女ロード
lines: Otome Road: the maidens' road. Books, goods and cafes for women fans, since the 2000s.
On a release day the line for one shop goes round the block, and nobody complains.

spots.name: GLOBAL RING
lines: Ikebukuro West Gate Park: the ring went up in 2019, over an open-air theatre. Orchestras play here on summer nights.
Before that it was a fountain and benches, and the kids from a famous TV drama hung out here. People still come looking for them.
The new volume's out today. They had a line round the block at nine.
Did you get the shop bonus?
Both versions. Don't tell my mother.
